lead_raw_text:
The structure of ErPt crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 8 atoms (Er4Pt4) and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis using CrystalNN shows both Er and Pt centers adopt a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, each with 8 geometric neighbors per center atom (4 Er and 4 Pt, distances 2.8381–2.8792 Å). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Er- and Pt-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing among like-centered polyhedra.
